findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Potential timing attack vulnerability
 * @description String comparisons that are not constant-time could leak information about secret keys
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/timing-attack
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-208
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("operator").getMember(["eq", "ne"]).getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("==").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("!=").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("hmac").getMember("compare_digest").getACall()
select call, "Comparison operation that may not be constant-time. Consider using hmac.compare_digest() for cryptographic comparisons."
findings.hypothesis: Timing attack vulnerability - non-constant-time comparisons in cryptographic operations

message.text: Comparison operation that may not be constant-time. Consider using hmac.compare_digest() for cryptographic comparisons.
